1: The deck of a seventeenth-century sailing ship at dawn under towering sails, rigging and rope, a heavy sea and mist: a French woman of about thirty-three with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a plain white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, stands at the rail with one hand on it, gazing out at the open ocean, in three-quarter view with her face clearly visible, a dark cloak over her shoulders, hard side light, solemn and steady. Colonists in dark clothes far behind her seen only as small silhouettes from behind. No children.
8: A narrow wooden pier on a wide river at dusk, mist, a small fort-town with a palisade in the distance: a French woman of about thirty-three with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a plain white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, stands at the end of the pier gazing across the water, small in the frame and seen from the side, her face faintly visible in profile, long shadows, hard low light. No other people, no children.
4: The deck of a seventeenth-century sailing ship at grey dawn: a French woman of about thirty-three with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a plain white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, stands at the bow as the ship nears a wooded riverbank and a small distant fort with a log palisade, her face clearly visible in three-quarter view, grave and wondering, a hard shaft of cold light, mist on the river, dark forest. No other people in the foreground, no children.
7: A small wooden riverside landing in front of a log palisade, a cold late autumn day, mist, bare dark forest behind: a French woman of about thirty-three with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a plain white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, stands alone on the muddy shore with a small bundle at her feet looking at the empty settlement, her face clearly visible in three-quarter view, patient and resolute, hard low light from one side. No other people, no children.
3: The lower deck of a seventeenth-century sailing ship at night, rough timbers and rope, a single swinging lantern: a French woman of about thirty-three with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a plain white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, sits on a wooden chest with her hands folded in her lap and her head slightly lifted, her face clearly visible in three-quarter view, lit by the lantern, patient and enduring, deep shadows. Other passengers only as dark shapes asleep far behind her. No children.
